description: This script analyzes documentation files in a project to identify missing glossary entries for terms found in markdown files, particularly focusing on internationalization aspects. It interacts with Git to determine changed files, reads a glossary JSON file, and extracts terms from documentation content.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for '--base' and '--head' options.

methods.name: runGit
methods.description: Executes a git command with specified arguments and returns the output.

methods.name: resolveBase
methods.description: Determines the base commit for comparison, using explicit input, environment variable, or common git merge-base candidates.

methods.name: listChangedDocs
methods.description: Lists documentation files that have changed between two commits.

methods.name: loadGlossarySources
methods.description: Loads the glossary JSON file and returns a set of source references.

methods.name: containsLatin
methods.description: Checks if a string contains Latin alphabet characters.

methods.name: wordCount
methods.description: Counts the number of words in a string.

methods.name: unquoteScalar
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a scalar string value.

methods.name: isGlossaryCandidate
methods.description: Determines if a term is a valid candidate for glossary inclusion based on length, content, and character set.

methods.name: readGitFile
methods.description: Reads the content of a file from a specific git commit/branch.

methods.name: extractTerms
methods.description: Extracts terms and their locations from a file's content based on YAML headers and markdown list links.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function coordinating argument parsing, git integration, glossary loading, and term extraction to identify missing glossary entries.
